name: trade_openness
genetic_identity: Trade openness is the scale of cross-border trade in goods and services relative to the size of the economy — not export sophistication, partner concentration, or development success.
description: Optional related Concept for multi-domain grounding demos. Primary series NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS (trade % of GDP).

atoms.name: is_trade_to_gdp_ratio
atoms.statement: Trade openness is measured as trade (exports plus imports of goods and services) as a percentage of GDP.

atoms.name: binds_to_wdi_trade_share
atoms.statement: Within WDI, the primary series is NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS.

atoms.name: is_not_development_outcome
atoms.statement: High trade openness is not by itself educational or human-capital success.

atoms.name: is_country_year_evaluable
atoms.statement: Openness is evaluable when NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS is non-null for the country-year.

rules.name: must_not_proxy_education_success
rules.statement: Using trade % GDP to rank educational success leaves this concept and invades education concepts without warrant.

rules.name: must_not_claim_diversification
rules.statement: Trade/GDP alone does not establish partner diversification or strategic resilience (different concepts; need Comtrade-style detail).

relations.note: Macro context only; not a substitute.

glossary.trade_openness: Trade as a percentage of GDP.
